conditions: Successfully decoded form body with POST sessionid and path present
assumptions: Synthetic handler_effect transcribed from cgi-io main_download; C, not ucode

cgi-io main_download requires session.access scope=cgi-io object=download function=read AND session.access scope=file object=canonicalize_path(path) function=read. A cgi-io grant without the file-read grant cannot authorize.
Path is canonicalized before the file ACL check so a '../' suffix cannot match an allowed glob prefix while open() resolves outside that prefix.
Successful form-body framing and URL decoding are preconditions
This oracle does not open, stat, or sendfile the target
shellquote and basename are not sanitizers. canonicalize_path is a textual path normalizer, not a taint sanitizer.
